visualCharacteristics.structure: 16:9 poster + centred play button + title link + date

contentPattern: Repeating video message cards: one row per card, cell 1 poster image, cell 2 link to the Scene7 video viewer URL (title as link text) + date paragraph. Renders 3-up (2 on tablet, 1 on mobile); clicking the play button or title opens the video in a modal, loaded lazily on click.
